scope: Same C method and rules across O3/O4a/O4b; fit parameters run-specific
protocol_stage: pre-test specification, not a claim that every adapter has been executed
waveform_components: conditional eta and chi_eff distributions given Mc

calibration.implementation_reference: archived o4b_hl_nso_score_20260912.py; data-dependent paths/metadata require an audited adapter

fusion.grid: simplex with step 0.05; normalize and deduplicate
fusion.tie_break: closest normalized weight to common anchor, then fixed lexicographic ordering

sky.score: log(Npix * sum(P_i * P_j)); probability mass, float64 accumulation
sky.ordering: native MOC is NESTED; use explicit NESTED-to-RING conversion at common pair-scoring entry
sky.temperature_selection: validation-only source-weighted coverage/CVM; same selection rule for all deployments
sky.trigger_inputs: matched-filter complex SNR recovered from the same raw noisy strain

evaluation.exact_ties: expected random tie order for retrieval; include all pairs at score threshold for F50/F90; explicitly audit tie frequency
evaluation.confidence: source/lens-group and noise-parent cluster sensitivity intervals reported separately, not independent pair bootstrap
evaluation.claim_scope: controlled exploratory comparison, not population lensing rate or catalog FAP

real_audit.PE_estimator_unified: same Gaussian-KDE Bhattacharyya integral and sample-standard-deviation D for all runs

acceptance: Deliver C regardless of improvement; report limitations; no automatic adoption
